input.command:
cat > diagnosis.json <<'EOF'
{"spec_element": "invariant",
 "proof_obligation": "preservation",
 "diagnosis": "The innermost loop `while (c != a)` in Determinant has no loop invariant bounding c. Without `a <= c <= M`, Dafny cannot show c stays within [a, M] across iterations: it cannot prove the guessed termination measure (c - a or similar) is bounded below/decreases, and it cannot prove the array index c-1 is within 0..M-1 for X[b-1,c-1] and X[a-1,c-1]. The missing invariant `a <= c <= M` (true on entry since c := M and a <= M, and maintained since c > a before decrement) fixes both."}
EOF
sed -i '69a\        invariant a <= c <= M;\n        decreases c - a;' program.dfy && sed -n 65,76p program.dfy && dafny verify program.dfy
